description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Mercury Systems is hiring a recent college graduate for its Rotational Engineering Program. The Software REP Engineer will design, develop, integrate, and test software and firmware for embedded and enterprise systems while rotating across technical disciplines and supporting the full development lifecycle.
Software Engineer in Rotational Program designing and testing software, maintaining firmware test suites, and supporting system-level validation

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and test software
• Develop and maintain software and firmware test suites to verify system capabilities and requirements
• Collaborate with engineering teams to enhance and support project development
• Partner with systems engineering, and customer support teams to reproduce, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues
• Support design teams in bring-up and system-level validation of products
• Contribute innovative ideas and state of the art thinking to improve business performance
• Deliver leading edge, integrated solutions that meet customer needs
• Participate in programs, projects, and initiatives aligned with Mercury's culture and strategy
• Stay informed on industry trends and ensure Mercury's best practices are met or exceeded
• Rotate through multiple technical disciplines to broaden skills and experience

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer engineering or computer science obtained between May 2026 and June 2027
• A minimum GPA of 3.1 is required
• Prior Co-Op or internship experience
• Experience with embedded programming on hardware
• Experience with C/C++
• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and troubleshooting skills
• Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively
• Experience presenting technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline driven environment
• Demonstrated initiative through academic projects, internships, or process improvements
• Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, or engineering concepts
• You may only access such information if you are a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. government

Preferred:
• Experience with lab equipment for data collection and processing
• Experience with C# or RUST
• Experience with Python
• Experience working in Linux environments
